name: @immunity-wars/manifest
description: The suite manifest: what each test suite proves, what it does not, and how PHASE1_BRIEF section 7 reconciles with what is on disk
comment:why-here: Lives under tests/ because it describes the test suites and is consumed by them, by the CI workflows (job matrix) and by the dashboard (one row per entry). It is a workspace member so that typecheck and lint reach it: a manifest nobody typechecks is the same class of problem as a generator that regenerates its own oracle.
